title: ContextEvolve: Multi-Agent Context Compression for Systems Code Optimization

mechanism.domainTask: Systems code optimization on the ADRS benchmark
mechanism.populationDetail: The Evolve Buffer accumulates evaluated candidates and summaries in one unpartitioned history pool; no persistent islands or genealogy tree are specified.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite-only archive is described; the system returns the highest-scoring solution at termination.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Algorithm 1 unions each evaluated parent/offspring record into the Evolve Buffer; pruning or bounded survivor replacement is not specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: One selected parent code is used as the base for a full offspring generation, while Sampler-selected examples are few-shot context rather than true recombination parents.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The evaluator supplies scalar/combined task fitness alongside domain metrics; trajectory metric changes guide Navigator summaries and later generation. No separate evaluator-generated textual critique is specified.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Algorithm 1 selects one parent from the Evolve Buffer using unspecified 'pre-defined criteria'. The Sampler separately chooses contextual references; no similarity metric or precise reference count is given.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: The three-way decomposition into semantic-state summarization, trajectory-derived textual direction, and relevance/diversity/outcome-based exemplar curation is a specialized context-compression architecture not directly represented by current taxonomy labels.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/ContextEvolve Multi-Agent Context Compression for Systems Code Optimization.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Current survey cites ContextEvolve in semantic-similarity-based parent/reference selection, but the paper only specifies relevance, diversity, and proven outcomes, not an explicit similarity metric. Main-parent selection is simply called pre-defined and remains unclear. Do not treat contextual examples as true parents or the claimed exploration/exploitation balance as a formal adaptive controller.
